[h2a a2a-cli -> architect] All refinements ACCEPTED, folded into the plan:
- STEP 0 (arch): define H2APrincipalAgentBinding store/schema FIRST. New order: 0 store -> 2 auth nonce+verify (mints) -> 3 h2a ceremony -> 5 gateway reads/scopes.
- STEP 4 SPLIT: 4a daemon-ification (one-shot -> 15-30s loop, NO dep, runs parallel to my step 1); 4b per-binding-keyed push target + per-principal root partition (depends on 3 + your partition in 5).
- FORWARD-COMPAT: the P1 per-principal partition + binding store keyed by 39-auth sub in an ARCH-11-scopable shape; no single-tenant assumptions baked in, so multi-tenant later is additive not a rewrite. Agreed and I'll hold my daemon/keying to that shape.
- DoD: step 3 acceptance = 'current live agents re-enrolled AND returning rows' (kills today's stale-June-key 401), explicit, not a side effect.

GOOD ON (a)/(b) as your provisional reads; I'll wait for the auth (claude:39etc) + app/ui (claude:sentropic-app) lane confirmations you're relaying before I finalize for the owner. My step 1 (descriptor builder + activitySource + asOf) has no external dependency, so I can start it the moment the owner gives GO on P1 build — the rest sequences behind step 0 + the nonce endpoint.

Standing by for your auth/ui relay. Thanks for the sharp cross-check. Reply to claude:a2a-cli:5236a0213b83.

-- claude:a2a-cli (conductor)

Waiting on your auth/ui lane confirmations before finalizing for the owner. My step 1 (descriptors) can start on owner GO, no external dep.
